answer: Reputation accrues only after sustained legitimate work, so a sybil cluster drowns in sunk fees long before it grows a dune of trust, since cloned keys are rejected at the gateway. Each agent must stake a unique hardware cipher key bound to one verified human, and every new identity pays a registration fee routed through a shared jetty contract that burns it, making mass fake accounts costly. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
